findings.summary: Stress workflow embeds dispatch inputs in shell source and accepts unbounded resource counts.
findings.reproduction: Inspect corelink-stress.yml setup n assignment and sleep source interpolation; count and hold_seconds are unvalidated workflow_dispatch strings.
findings.acceptance: Env-only quoted input passage; reject nondecimal/out-of-range count (1..100) and hold_seconds (1..300) before dispatch; injection sentinel never executes; final result rejects failed/skipped/cancelled stress.

findings.summary: Held lease restart loses provider binding; old teardown treats unknown local state as confirmed provider absence. Durable provider identity is not persisted.
findings.reproduction: Acquire via real provider, persist Held row, recreate provider with empty registry, expire lease. cloud_exec real teardown currently returns Ok on missing binding; box_ref only stores box:lease marker.
findings.acceptance: Never terminalize Held or free capacity without exact-handle provider confirmation; retain handle through ledger finish failure; restart recovery must persist/resolve authoritative provider identity and reclaim same container after confirmation.
findings.resolution: Unknown identity no longer confirms absence; new Held records have durable bindings before transition and restore exact provider domain/handle/route. Residual discovery/liveness is explicitly split into F-20260905-005; not universal recovery or live proof.

findings.summary: DevEnv credential rectification needs authenticated server issuance and binding; current public body forwards raw PAT and server cross-worker binding is absent. Monthly ceiling is also not enforced by existing server guard.
findings.reproduction: Inspect sibling corelink-server HEADc0a4466 worker/src/index.ts DevEnv arm, wrangler.toml, session_exchange mint authority and devenv_guard.ts; guard reads max_vcpu_h without consumption predicate.
findings.acceptance: Server-authenticated tenant/session grant authorizes only bounded CAS credential; no raw PAT container env/customer-selected broker record; authorized route/binding and finite cleanup/revocation are wired; metering/ceiling outcome matches ratified hard-stop contract.

findings.summary: Durable server relay revocation repair is authored and tested as an unapplied artifact; application/migration/paired validation remain pending.
findings.reproduction: Relay artifact 2158fbc: successful mint, unavailable start RPC, two revoke failures; only diagnostic and PAT expiry remain, no restart-safe cleanup record.
findings.acceptance: Persist the exact issued credential cleanup obligation before RPC handoff; retain through failed revoke and restart; retry boundedly until idempotent revoke or confirmed adoption. Explicitly account for issuance/persistence atomicity and finite expiry; no token logging or falsely confirmed cleanup.

findings.summary: Authoritative reconciliation is still needed for provider creation before durable reference persistence and historical fabric records without exact identity; Cloudflare and Northflank must both be covered.
findings.reproduction: Crash after provider create succeeds but before bind_provider_ref commits, or reopen a historical box:lease row with an empty local registry. Current code correctly retains Pending/Held and capacity; it cannot discover the exact resource from that marker.
findings.acceptance: Cloudflare: persist authoritative attempt/DO identity before start, integrate the Rust caller, prove exact cancellation against late creation, and reconcile historical unknown rows without treating inventory absence as deletion. Northflank: separately implement/prove equivalent scoped operation identity, cancellation/idempotency and historical discovery. Neither backend may invent handles or reclaim capacity on ambiguous absence. Retain explicit unresolved records until authoritative confirmation.
